title: One recorded handwriting line (raw capture, v1)

id.description: UUID v4; also the file name -> uploads are idempotent

seq.description: 0-based index of this line within the session

writer_id.description: short name or nickname chosen in the app, as a slug

writer_name.description: the name as typed in the app (display name of writer_id)

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC wall clock when the line was accepted

text.description: what was actually written (NFC). Equals prompt.text unless the writer corrected the transcription (then text_edit is set).

text_edit.description: set when the writer corrected text afterwards in the app ("Meine Zeilen"); prompt.text is never changed

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC wall clock of the latest correction

original.description: text as it was when the line was recorded

count.description: how often the text was corrected

status.description: skipped/redone attempts are never uploaded as samples

edits.description: what the writer removed on this line (counts only; removed strokes are never stored)

undo.description: Rückgängig steps that changed the sheet (also taking back an erase or Löschen)

erase.description: Radieren: a stroke and everything written after it removed

erased_strokes.description: strokes removed by those erases, counted when done

spot.description: single stray marks removed (only strokes qa calls stray)

removed_t.description: [t_first, t_last] spans (this record's time base) of strokes recorded on this line but not stored; consecutive ones merged. A pause covering such a span contained removed writing

flags.description: automatic QA flags, e.g. stroke_count_low, stroke_count_high, out_of_bounds, stray_stroke, pointercancel, touch_during_writing, button_pressed, low_rate, layout_changed, late_stroke (a stroke added later well left of the ink before it)

t0_epoch_ms.description: performance.timeOrigin + event.timeStamp of the first pen-down of the line (t = 0). That pen-down may belong to a stroke removed later on its own (a stray mark); the first stored t is then above 0 and edits.removed_t starts at 0. Timestamps are never shifted

unit.description: v1 recorder always writes css_px; device_px only for converted legacy data

canvas_css.description: [width,height] of the canvas in CSS px

canvas_client_rect.description: [left,top,width,height] from getBoundingClientRect() at first pen-down (t = 0, see time.t0_epoch_ms); the layout cannot move during a line

mm_per_unit.description: physical size of one coordinate unit, null if unknown

guides.description: everything drawn on the canvas besides ink, in the same coordinates as the strokes, and how the ink looked. Display only: the samples are raw whatever is reported here

extra_lines_y.description: horizontal guide lines drawn besides the baseline (ruled or squared paper)

ink_width_css.description: nominal ink width chosen by the writer (CSS px)

pressure_width.description: true when the shown width followed pen pressure

pen.description: fineliner: constant width; fueller: width follows smoothed pressure; bleistift: grey graphite whose tone follows pressure

spacing_css.description: distance between ruled or squared lines (CSS px); absent for a single baseline

display_changed.description: the look was changed while the line was being written; the fields above give the final look

t.description: ms since time.base, strictly increasing over the whole line

p.description: PointerEvent.pressure 0..1, stored as delivered (0 is legal)

up.description: the pointerup/pointercancel sample, kept OUT of the arrays (its pressure is 0 by spec)

anomalies.description: recorder counters. cancelled, button_strokes and dt_gt_10ms come from the stored strokes; touch_ignored, non_monotonic and same_t_dropped cover everything since the line was last empty (a Löschen starts them over), removed writing included

legacy.description: only on converted old recordings: source path, old schema version, known defects
